summary: Example NETCONF task backs up config with netconf_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up config over NETCONF?

answer_card.title: Back up config over NETCONF
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config
  junipernetworks.junos.netconf_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_junos_location
```
